items.name: Real.logb_lt_logb

items.name: ENNReal.log_lt_log
items.type: ∀ {x y : ENNReal}, x < y → x.log < y.log

items.name: Real.log_lt_log
items.type: ∀ {x y : ℝ}, 0 < x → x < y → Real.log x < Real.log y

items.name: Real.log_lt_log_iff
items.type: ∀ {x y : ℝ}, 0 < x → 0 < y → (Real.log x < Real.log y ↔ x < y)

items.name: Real.log_le_log_iff
items.type: ∀ {x y : ℝ}, 0 < x → 0 < y → (Real.log x ≤ Real.log y ↔ x ≤ y)
